text:
anya: Quick sync — building the long-term platform roadmap for routing policies + multi-region multi-tenant isolation. I want a proposed MVP scope and launch criteria by EOD Friday so PM/Eng can align with sales asks.

michael: +1. Sales flagged two customers (AcmeCorp, BetaBank) asking for per-tenant routing rules, region pinning, and an SLA tier that guarantees regional failover within 30s. They want pricing clearly tied to isolation level.

raj: Proposed phased approach:
- Phase 0 (MVP): tenant affinity + soft-slicing (no dedicated GPU pools), policy DSL for region hints, graceful fallback to compatible model variants.
- Phase 1: tenant slices with resource reservations and quota gating, canary migration tools.
- Phase 2: hard isolation (dedicated pools, data plane separation), certified compliance add-ons.

sarah: Product asks: separate "must-have" vs "sales-enabling" features. Must-have for MVP = affinity + fallback + rollout story (canary/rollback). Sales-enabling = dedicated pools and per-tenant SLAs.

michael: Technical constraints to call out:
- Autoscaling + reservation interplay (we need a capacity gating design so bursts don't starve other tenants)
- Model compatibility matrix for fallback (e.g., quantized vs float models)
- Cross-region KV cache coherency implications for latency-sensitive apps

raj: Initial launch criteria (v1):
- Routing policy DSL v0 implemented and covered by unit/integration tests
- Fallback policy verified in staging (simulated AZ and region failures)
- Migration runbook + canary plan documented
- Performance gate: p95 latency regression < 10% vs baseline on our standard prompt set
- Cost gate: estimated per-token cost increase < 15% for affinity path

sarah: Also need clear acceptance for sales handoff: example pricing tiers mapped to isolation levels, and a short customer-facing FAQ about behavior during failover. :clipboard:

oncall-bot: deploy-bot: Staging chaos test started: region-eu failure simulation triggered at 1934567920.

raj: Routing policy snippet for discussion (DSL prototype):
```
policy:
  id: tenant-affinity-1
  mode: affinity
  region_preference: [region-us, region-eu]
  fallback: region-global
  allowed_models: ["redwood-v2", "redwood-lite"]
  sla_tier: gold
```
This lets us express simple affinity + fallback without hard isolation.

michael: For scope negotiation with customers: offer a two-track commitment — a guaranteed "soft isolation" SLA (affinity + fast failover) for self-serve, and an "isolated pools" enterprise offering with reserved capacity and pricing.

anya: Action items:
- raj: draft RFC and routing DSL spec by Tue (owner)
- michael: put together customer SLAs and pricing options by Wed
- sarah: prepare one-pager for sales and customer success
- eng infra: run staging chaos tests and perf hangoffs this week
Acceptance metrics: p95 delta <10%, no data-plane cross-tenant leakage in tenancy tests, and cost uplift within gating threshold.

anya: Let's sync 30m tomorrow to approve RFC before it goes to ENG-ARCH board. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
